full_prompt_en: A square painterly scene shows a woman sitting quietly in a meadow beside a narrow lake. She is seen in side profile, turned toward the right, with a dark updo and a vivid turquoise high-neck blouse above a long charcoal skirt. Her hands rest in her lap and her posture is still, giving the scene a reflective mood. Tall green grass and tiny pale flowers surround the skirt, softening its edge into the field. Behind her, the lake forms a thin cool band, followed by dark conifer trees and hazy blue mountains. The figure sits slightly left of center and occupies much of the foreground, while the landscape recedes gently in horizontal layers. Dense, small oil-paint touches describe grasses, hair, and trees; softer dragged strokes render the distant haze. The turquoise blouse is the strongest color note against olive greens, subdued browns, and blue-gray shadows. Diffuse daylight touches the face and fabric without a harsh highlight. A lightly textured canvas surface and visible pigment flecks keep the image tactile. The whole frame balances intimate portraiture with open air and distance, holding a quiet late-summer stillness rather than narrative action or polished realism.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形绘画呈现一位女子安静地坐在狭长湖边的草地上。她以侧面朝右，深色头发盘起，鲜明的青绿色高领上衣搭配长长的炭灰色裙子。双手放在膝上，姿态静止，使场景带有沉思气息。高草和细小浅色野花围住裙摆，让边缘柔化进草地。身后湖面是一条窄窄的冷色带，再往后是深色针叶树林和朦胧蓝山。人物略偏左，且占据前景较大面积；风景则以水平层次轻轻后退。密集细小的油画触点描绘草、头发和树木；远山薄雾由更柔和的拖笔表现。青绿色上衣是橄榄绿、低饱和棕和蓝灰阴影中最强的色彩。漫射日光轻轻触及面孔和布料，没有硬亮光。轻微起伏的画布表面和可见颜料斑点使画面可触。整幅画平衡亲密的人物描绘与开阔空气和远景，保留夏末般的安静，而非叙事动作或抛光写实。
style_prompt_en: A quiet oil-painting language combines fine broken touches in the foreground with soft dragged strokes in distant layers. Muted olive, moss green, blue-gray, and earth brown form a cool natural field, with one concentrated turquoise accent carrying the visual focus. Shapes separate through gentle value shifts and atmospheric recession rather than hard outlines. Small pale flecks animate textured surfaces without disrupting the calm. Diffuse daylight keeps contrast moderate and gives fabric or another focal plane a soft lift. A slightly off-center primary form rests within horizontal bands of middle ground and haze. Visible pigment and canvas grain preserve the hand-worked quality of the scene.
style_prompt_zh: 安静的油画语言把前景细小破碎笔触与远方层次中的柔和拖笔结合。低饱和橄榄绿、苔绿、蓝灰和泥土棕组成偏冷的自然色域，由一处集中的青绿色点缀承担视觉焦点。形体通过温和明度差与空气透视分离，而不是硬轮廓。浅色细小斑点活跃有肌理的表面，却不打破平静。漫射日光让反差适中，使布料或其他焦点色面轻轻提亮。略偏中心的主形体安放在中景和薄雾的水平色带中。可见颜料与画布颗粒保留亲手绘制的质感。
theme_en: A woman in a turquoise blouse sitting alone in a meadow beside a lake
theme_zh: 一位穿青绿色上衣的女子独坐湖畔草地
name: L. Birge Harrison
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
